images.caption: On a blog with ads or affiliate links, NC images are the ones to skip entirely.

images.title: Checks before using an AI image
images.alt: Checklist for AI-generated blog images: read commercial terms, avoid real people and logos, don't assume ownership, ask if it adds value.
images.caption: AI tools suit abstract or decorative images, as long as the terms and subject matter are clear.

items: Read the tool's terms for commercial use
Check whether free and paid tiers have different terms
Don't assume you own the result
Ask whether it adds more than a stock photo would

images.after: Make your own graphics instead of decorating with stock
images.title: Graphics nobody else has
images.alt: Four kinds of original blog graphics: charts from your own data, annotated screenshots, simple diagrams and your own photos.
images.caption: The most useful image in a post explains something and can't turn up on another site.

items.title: Charts from your own data
items.text: Label the axes, cut the gridlines and say where the numbers came from.

items.title: Annotated screenshots
items.text: An arrow and a short label on the exact button to click.

items.title: Simple diagrams
items.text: Boxes and arrows for a process, or a two-column comparison.
